units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Why do humans care about art?" The voice now seems far away yet more present than ever. "Because it amazes you, the same way it amazes us to see another kind grow and overcome their burdens. The lives of others are like a painting that never stops being painted, but is a tragic thing to watch the painting stop. That is why we try to protect these creations of life - so we can see what heights they reach."|52|0

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|log|197|0
units.english: Assisted a stranded alien vessel in an uninhabited system whose crew members appeared similar to floating octopi or jellyfish. Could not communicate with them due to the language barrier, but managed to give them the equipment they needed to repair their ship. You continue your attempt to assist the ship, preparing to bring some repair supplies on board.`

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	You manage to dock to the disabled ship quite easily. The hatch opens and as a hallway opens up before you, it is immediately obvious that this ship was not designed for humans. The walls are strangely curved, and the floor has nearly no grip at all. As you carry the repair equipment into the ship, your view is caught by five giant aliens - half octopod, half jellyfish in appearance. They pulsate in bright colors similar to the gradients that appeared on your screen earlier. One of them is floating behind what's clearly a giant mounted weapon, and the two barrels are pointed right at you. The alien gunner flashes in an orange light, and you can feel the tension in the room rising.|201|0

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	Feeling that the situation could escalate any moment, you slowly place the crate with the repair equipment on the ground and walk back a few steps. You are careful not to make any hasty movements. Both you and the aliens are still for a moment until one of them slowly floats forward. Tones of yellow are now mixing into the creature's orange color, and two of their tentacles wrap around the crate while the other four back off in response. units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	As you fly away you see the engines of the ship slowly booting back up. Apparently they figured out how to use the repair equipment. Instead of leaving the system, however, the ship begins to fly towards a nearby gas giant.|217|0

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	Back on your ship, your eyes fall on the scanner log that is still open on your monitor. Notably, this ship had no hyperdrive or anything similar installed, which is strange considering there is no inhabited planet in this system. Maybe you should talk to the Quarg and see if they have any insight on this.|218|0
units.english: Back on your ship, your eyes fall on the scanner log that is still open on your monitor. Notably, this ship had no hyperdrive or anything similar installed, which is strange considering there is no inhabited planet in this system. Maybe you should talk to the Quarg and see if they have any insight on this.
units.raw: `	Back on your ship, your eyes fall on the scanner log that is still open on your monitor. Notably, this ship had no hyperdrive or anything similar installed, which is strange considering there is no inhabited planet in this system. Maybe you should talk to the Quarg and see if they have any insight on this.`
